purpose: Correct a conclusion or deny that it applies without qualification.
keywords: Plain form + わけではない; noun / な-adjective + な + わけではない
It is not that I dislike it; I just do not want to eat it today.
Being expensive does not necessarily make something good.
Reject an inference or deny a guarantee
わけではない · correct a conclusion
とは限らない · allow exceptions
formation: Plain form + わけではない; noun / な-adjective + な + わけではない
restrictions: May mean not necessarily or it is not that, depending on what is being denied.
mistake: It need not deny every instance; it often rejects an overgeneralization.
